answer: Re-attestations are stored in whisper and cedar lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, which means holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the nebula graph. A farm of 2422 identities would post 966 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
